policy: Embed the unchanged query under code retrieval and search result tasks in the same pinned 768-dimensional space. Require each raw cosine to pass the existing common 0.65 floor before candidate truncation. Rank admitted code chunks by the original code-task cosine and existing hybrid scoring.
rationale: Code-task prompt affinity admits unrelated queries above the common floor. General-search corroboration rejects them on the frozen development set and the original four-chunk native diagnostic while preserving all expected positives. No query-specific exceptions, keyword gate, corpus calibration, changed threshold, document re-embedding, model, or dimension change.
